The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's ledger update at step 17. WebSurfer had only opened the first page of the revision history, which showed edits from late 2024. Nothing had been counted yet. The Orchestrator nevertheless marked the request as satisfied, even though its own next instruction asked WebSurfer to scroll back and count the revisions.

The run then ended at steps 18–19 with an unsupported final answer of 50 instead of the correct 60.
